faq.title: Find answers to your questions here
faq.subtitle: Gain a more comprehensive understanding through our curated list of questions and answers.

general.a: Kompeten IDN is a digital education platform designed to support modern skill development across fields ranging from accounting, economics, taxation, technology, to design.
Kompeten offers various services such as Online Classes, Bootcamps, Webinars, and Certification Programs.

general.q: Is this training open to the public?
general.a: Certainly, our training is open to college students, fresh graduates, and professionals looking to enhance their skills in accounting, economics, taxation, technology, and design.

general.q: How do I register for training at Kompeten?
general.a: Registration can be completed directly through our website or via the registration link in our Instagram bio @kompeten.idn. You only need to fill out the form and confirm your payment.

general.q: Can I register for more than one program at the same time?
general.a: Yes, absolutely. However, please ensure that Live Class schedules do not conflict so you can get the most out of each interactive session.

general.q: Where can I get more information about Kompeten?
general.a: You can reach our admin at +6289528514480 or follow Kompeten's social media accounts on Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

general.q: How do I enroll in my desired class?
general.a: You can enroll by clicking the "Register" button on the class page, completing the registration form, and making your payment.

learning.q: How does the learning path work at Kompeten?
learning.a: Your learning journey at Kompeten begins with selecting your chosen class or bootcamp. You will then receive instant access to learning materials available anytime, complete with modules, quizzes, and discussion forums.

learning.q: Are classes held offline or online?
learning.a: Currently, all our training is held Online via Zoom (Live Sessions) and our Learning Management System (LMS) for self-paced study.

learning.q: What if I am unable to attend a Live Class session?
learning.a: No worries. Every session is recorded, and recordings can be re-accessed anytime without any expiration. Recordings are uploaded within a maximum of 24 hours after the session ends.

learning.q: How long do I have access to training materials?
learning.a: Access to learning materials (video recordings and modules) is lifetime without time limits, allowing you to review at your own pace.

certificate.a: Yes, every participant who completes the training and fulfills completion criteria (such as completing post-tests or assignments) receives an official e-certificate from Kompeten IDN.

certificate.q: Can certificates from Kompeten IDN be used for job applications?
certificate.a: Absolutely, our certificates list all competencies covered, bolstering your resume and portfolio in the eyes of recruiters.

certificate.q: How can I verify the credibility of the e-certificate?
certificate.a: Each e-certificate includes a scannable QR code displaying participant credentials, training date, and program enrolled, preventing unauthorized tampering.

payment.a: Payments can be made via QRIS, Bank Transfer via Virtual Account, and e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA).

payment.q: What if my payment has not been confirmed?
payment.a: If payment is not confirmed within 24 hours, please contact our support team along with your proof of payment.

payment.q: What should I do after completing my payment?
payment.a: After completing payment, you can confirm with our admin (MinKo) or directly join the WhatsApp group.

technical.q: What device do I need to attend the training?
technical.a: We recommend using a laptop or PC (Windows or Mac), or a tablet for ease during practical exercises.

technical.q: I'm having trouble logging into the member area, what should I do?
technical.a: Please use the "Forgot Password" feature on the login page. If the issue persists, contact our admin (MinKo) at +62 895-2851-4480.

technical.q: How do I reset my password?
technical.a: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page, enter your registered email address, and follow the instructions sent to your inbox.

technical.q: What if course videos cannot be played?
technical.a: Ensure your internet connection is stable, update your browser, and try clearing your browser cache.
